描述_EN: granted in 1769, gules three martlets between two chevronels argent (tinctures transposed) with a crest which should be a demi lion rampant per fess ermine and gules ducally crowned or, quartering small, sable on a bend argent three roses gules barbed vert, in the sinister chief point a chess rook of the second, with a coat of pretence and the same accollée, or three cocks gules, probably for cockburn. the arms are marshalled in an interesting manner; peach of rooksmore in gloucs. plate, porcelain, of shallow octagonal form with spreading rim, painted in famille rose enamels and gold with arms of peach quartering small with in pretence and accollée cockburn. all over design is painted within a black and gold border of a chinese family in a garden by a house, a boy flying a butterfly kite, a river landscape behind. the two shields are set in an elaborate framework interlaced with floral sprays.
描述_ZN: 1769年被授予，三个小马特，位于两道雪佛龙之间（酊剂换位），有一个徽章，应该是一个半狮横卧在朱红色和朱红色的公爵冠或，四分之一的小，在一个弯曲处，有三个玫瑰花，朱红色的倒刺，在阴面的首席点一个国际象棋的第二个，有一个假装的外套和相同的accollée，或三个公鸡朱红色，可能代表cockburn。 the arms are marshalled in an interesting manner; peach of rooksmore in gloucs. 瓷盘，浅八角形，有展开的边缘，用粉彩和金彩绘出桃花四角形的手臂，上面有假装和鸡冠花。 在黑色和金色的边框内画了一个中国家庭在花园里的房子，一个男孩在放蝴蝶风筝，后面是河流景观。 这两个盾牌被镶嵌在一个精心设计的框架中，上面交错着花卉图案。
